name: ai-blob-warp
title: AI Blob Warp
description: A round avatar whose fill is an animated warp shader: thin liquid bands of blue, pink and purple that slowly twist and breathe. It stops animating off-screen or when reduced motion is set.
use: An AI assistant needs a compact identity mark that feels alive without loading a video or image.
avoid: It is a WebGL shader per instance, so many avatars add up, and the detail is lost at small sizes.
a11y: The shader is hidden from assistive tech and the root has no role, so a passed aria-label may not be announced. (keyboard: n-a, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A small perfect circle with a dark base crossed by curling ribbons of cyan, blue and magenta, like oil on water. A thin border and a faint inner glow separate it from the black page.
behaves: The swirling bands drift and fold continuously while the circle quietly scales and rotates a degree or two back and forth. It freezes when scrolled out of view.
customise: All shader settings are passed through warpProps: colours, swirl, distortion, scale, shape and speed; size and shape come from className.
weight: heavy: Each avatar runs its own WebGL warp shader every frame; several on screen multiply the cost.
demo: Chat with Atlas about churn, plus small pink, ocean and forest avatars.
issues: Small sizes turn the swirl into a soft blur with little visible detail.
polishWhy: Rich, organic gradient mark that suits an assistant; the pattern blurs away at small sizes.
